mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 7.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market and potential recession, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) is above 230 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.1%, the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 230 AND FEDFUNDS < 0.1

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (HOUST > 900 and INDPRO > 100), the economy is overbought and vulnerable to a correction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in < 40% of instances when HOUST > 900 AND INDPRO > 100

mechanism_narrative: A high CPIAUCSL (inflation) increases the risk of monetary tightening and reduces real equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 230

mechanism_narrative: A high level of employment (PAYEMS > 130000) indicates a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95, it signals a weakening economy and potential recession, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
